posts.text: data engineer: vengeance mode vs agent mode

October at Bruin: AI that fills in your columns, reverse ETL that puts them in your CRM, and Bruin on the Slack and Teams marketplaces.

What we shipped:

→ Inference assets: ask a model a question about every row and get a typed column back. Every answer is checked against its type and allowed choices.
→ Reverse ETL, now part of ingestr: sync tested tables to HubSpot, Salesforce, Attio and CleverTap. A failing check holds the sync.
→ Bruin is listed on the Slack Marketplace and Microsoft Marketplace.
→ bruin import ssis: turn SSIS packages and SQL Server Agent jobs into a Bruin pipeline.
→ CDC from a Postgres 16+ read replica, plus snapshot-free starts, hard deletes and StarRocks as a destination.
→ Quality checks for your semantic layer, with bruin semantic check.
→ In Bruin Cloud: rerun options, resizable dashboards, AI cost by agent, asset health and alerts to any webhook.

Details in the carousel, links in the comments.

Halloween is a nice break from the usual horror, for many data people.
If it gets too spooky, look for the pink bear 🐾

What can you get done in a second?
If you run on ingestr, move 10,000 rows from MySQL to Postgres. Twice.

- 160 sources
- 40 destinations
- Fastest in 76 of 79 benchmarks against Airbyte, dlt, Sling and Spark
